app.footer: Officials and system admins sign in with a passkey.
app.demoFooter: This demonstration runs only in the demo tenant. Nothing here is a real election.

home.title: SureVote election workspace
home.intro: SureVote keeps an election authority's record and a public ballot ledger. This workspace configures the parts of an election. Voters check their ballots on the separate public lookup.
home.workspaceBody: Configure a tenant, geography, contests, and recording places. On a showcase tenant, activate a demonstration, cast one ballot, and close it. The access code appears once and is not saved in this browser.
home.workspaceKeys: This browser does not hold a production operator, import, viewing, or device key. On a production tenant, activate and close take a signature made outside this app.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Officials and system admins sign in with a passkey. A security key or a platform passkey both work.
signIn.passkeyBody: Use a passkey you already enrolled.
signIn.enrollBody: Paste the one-time enrollment token you were given. It works once and expires after 24 hours.
signIn.enrolled: Passkey enrolled. You are signed in.
signIn.devBody: This host allows sign-in without a passkey. A production host turns it off.

admin.title: Officials
admin.signInLink: Sign in as an official or a system admin
admin.signInBody: You need to sign in to manage officials.
admin.intro: An official gets a one-time enrollment token and enrolls a passkey on the sign-in page. A disabled official is signed out at once.
admin.tokenBody: Give this token to the official. It is not shown again.

accessCode.copied: Access code copied to the clipboard.
accessCode.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it yourself.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.body: Counts per recording place. A polling place matches when issued plus received equals its ballots. A central office handles mail: unreturned mailed ballots stay issued, so it matches when received equals ballots. Received marks are written in batches, so a recent ballot can show as not matched yet.

workspace.title: Configure an election
workspace.intro: Create each part, then run a showcase demonstration. A production activate or close still needs a signature made outside this app. This browser does not hold a production private key.
workspace.officialTenant: Signed in as {{name}}. Everything here is created in your tenant.
workspace.visitorTenant: Everything here is created in the shared demo tenant {{name}}. It has no legal effect. A system admin creates every other tenant.
workspace.visitorTenantUnnamed: Everything here is created in the shared demo tenant. It has no legal effect. A system admin creates every other tenant.

locality.title: Locality
locality.detail: The city or town the election belongs to.

address.title: Address
address.detail: The address used by the precinct and the polling place.

precinct.title: Precinct
precinct.detail: Where the voter's ballot style is drawn from.

district.title: District
district.detail: Optional. An at-large seat does not need one.

precinctDistrict.title: Precinct district
precinctDistrict.detail: Optional. Ties the precinct to one district of that type.

seat.title: Seat
seat.detail: The office on the ballot. Appointments is how many winners the seat has.

showcaseElection.title: Showcase election
showcaseElection.detail: The host generates the operator, import, and viewing keys. The window must include now.

productionElection.title: Production election
productionElection.detail: Optional. Paste public keys generated outside this app. Leave this blank for a demonstration.

race.title: Race
race.detail: One chain is created for this race.

candidatePerson.title: Candidate person
candidatePerson.detail: A fictional name is enough. A showcase tenant rejects an SSN and a voter id.

voter.title: Voter
voter.detail: Accepted onto the pollbook when the demonstration ballot is cast. Not written onto the ballot.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.detail: The candidate row points at the person.

slot.title: Race slot
slot.detail: One choice on the race. Write-in stays No for this demonstration.

place.title: Recording place
place.detail: The polling place named on the ballot. This is not the voter's home.

showcaseDevice.title: Showcase device
showcaseDevice.detail: Create this before activate. The host generates the device key.

productionDevice.title: Production device
productionDevice.detail: Optional. Paste a device public key generated on the machine. Create it before activate.

assignment.title: Precinct assignment
assignment.detail: The precinct is open for this election.

activate.title: Activate the demonstration
activate.detail: The host signs the definition. Do this after the device, the style, and the assignment exist.

cast.title: Cast a demonstration ballot
cast.detail: One first-past-the-post choice, value Y, for the slot above. The voter is accepted on the pollbook and is not stored on the ballot.

code.title: Access code
code.once: This code is shown once. It is not saved in this browser. Copy it before you leave or clear this page.
code.gone: The access code was shown once and is no longer on this page.

close.title: Close the demonstration
close.detail: The host signs each race chain and the canvass statement. Open disputes do not block close.

productionActivate.title: Production activate
productionActivate.detail: Paste the operator signature over the definition hash. The hash comes from outside this app.

productionClose.title: Production close
productionClose.detail: Paste one chain signature and the canvass signature. Both are made outside this app.
